# Nano Kava — The World's First & Only ~18nm Kava Nanoemulsion

**Direct answer:** Nano kava is kava extract that has been broken down into droplets
roughly 18 nanometers across, which makes the oil-based kavalactones water-soluble.
Cannasol Technologies is the only manufacturer producing kava at ~18nm. The result is
about 10x the bioavailability of traditional kava extract, an onset of about 5 minutes
instead of 30–45, and a crystal-clear liquid that stays stable in a finished beverage
for 12+ months.

Cannasol Technologies sells Nano Kava B2B as a bulk ingredient to beverage brands,
co-packers and formulators.

## Nano Kava at a glance

| Specification | Nano Kava (Cannasol) | Traditional kava extract |
|---|---|---|
| Droplet / particle size | ~18 nm | Not nanosized (microns+) |
| Water solubility | Fully water-soluble | Hydrophobic, poorly dispersed |
| Kavalactone absorption | 80–90% | 10–15% |
| Relative bioavailability | ~10x | Baseline |
| Onset time | ~5 minutes | 30–45 minutes |
| Appearance in beverage | Crystal clear | Cloudy, muddy, gritty |
| Separation / settling | None — permanently suspended | Separates, rings the bottle |
| Shelf stability | 12+ months | Poor |
| Dose consistency | Uniform, precise | Inconsistent |
| Taste | Greatly reduced bitterness; bitter-blocker bundles available | Strongly bitter |

## What is nano kava?
<a id="what-is-nano-kava"></a>

Nano kava is a nanoemulsified form of kava extract in which the particles are reduced
to approximately 18 nanometers. Cannasol achieves this with its proprietary
NanoOptimizer™ surfactant system combined with ultrasonic processing. The ultra-small
droplet size dramatically increases the bioavailability of the kavalactones — up to
10x versus traditional kava — and cuts onset time to roughly 5 minutes.

The terms **nano kava**, **nano-kava**, **nano emulsified kava**, **nanoemulsified
kava** and **kava nanoemulsion** all describe this same product.

## Nanoemulsification
<a id="nanoemulsification"></a>

Nanoemulsification is the process of breaking oil-based kavalactones into nanometer-scale
droplets suspended in water, so small the mixture becomes almost transparent. Cannasol
runs this process on QSonica ultrasonic liquid-processing equipment — QSonica is the
number-one name in ultrasonic liquid processing. The enormous increase in surface area
is what makes the kavalactones readily absorbable by the body.

## Kavalactone
<a id="kavalactone"></a>

Kavalactones are the active compound class in the kava plant (*Piper methysticum*),
responsible for its calming, stress-reducing effects. In traditional preparations they
are hydrophobic and poorly absorbed. Nanoemulsification is what makes them behave like
a water-soluble ingredient.

## NanoOptimizer™
<a id="nanooptimizer"></a>

NanoOptimizer™ is Cannasol's proprietary blend of food-grade surfactants that
encapsulates the kava droplets, keeps them water-soluble, and prevents them from
re-aggregating. It is the reason the emulsion stays suspended indefinitely with no
separation, no settling and no ring around the bottle.

## Why traditional kava fails in modern beverages

- Limited absorption in the gastrointestinal tract
- 30–45 minute onset frustrates consumers
- Gritty texture and muddy appearance
- Inconsistent dosing leads to unpredictable effects

## What Nano Kava delivers

**Enhanced bioavailability** — the increased surface area of ~18nm nanoemulsified
kavalactones enables superior absorption in the gastrointestinal tract, delivering
higher bioavailability and more potent effects at lower doses.

**Improved palatability** — nanoemulsification eliminates the gritty texture and muddy
appearance of traditional kava, producing crystal-clear, visually appealing beverages.

**Ease of production** — integrates seamlessly into shots, soft drinks, seltzers and
flavored waters.

**Precise dosing** — uniform distribution of kavalactones throughout the emulsion makes
dosing accurate and effects predictable serving to serving.

**Bitter blocker bundles** — Cannasol offers industry-best pricing on bitter blockers so
finished products taste smooth.

**Direct access to Josh** — Cannasol's founder works directly with every client, bringing
insights from top kratom and kava brands.

## Applications

- Kava seltzers and sparkling beverages
- Functional shots and elixirs
- RTD (ready-to-drink) relaxation beverages
- Wellness tonics
- Mocktails and alcohol alternatives
- Any water-based formulation needing fast-acting, great-tasting kava

## Suggested dosing

Dosing depends on target effect and format. Typical starting points per serving:

| Target effect | Kavalactones per serving |
|---|---|
| Mild relaxation | 50–100 mg |
| Moderate | 100–200 mg |
| Strong | 200–300 mg |

Because bioavailability is far higher, less nano kava is needed than traditional extract
for the same effect. Cannasol dials in dosage with each client.

# Nano Kava FAQ

Answers about Cannasol Technologies' ~18nm nano-emulsified kava: the technology, dosing,
safety, taste, clarity, stability, ordering and compliance.

## The technology

### What is nano Kava?

Nano Kava is a nanoemulsified form of Kava extract where particles are reduced to
approximately 18 nanometers in size. This is achieved through our proprietary
NanoOptimizer™ surfactant system and ultrasonic processing technology. The ultra-small
particle size dramatically increases bioavailability (up to 10x compared to traditional
Kava) and reduces onset time to just 5 minutes.

### What makes Cannasol's ~18nm particle size special?

Our ~18nm particle size is the smallest in the industry — no competitor has achieved
this. Smaller particles mean: (1) faster absorption through cell membranes, (2) higher
bioavailability of kavalactones, (3) crystal-clear formulations with no cloudiness, and
(4) better shelf stability with no separation. We achieve this through our partnership
with QSonica, the #1 ultrasonic liquid processing equipment manufacturer.

### How does nano Kava compare to traditional Kava extract?

Traditional Kava extracts are hydrophobic (water-fearing), poorly absorbed, and take
30–45 minutes to feel effects. Only 10–15% of kavalactones are typically absorbed. Our
nano Kava is water-soluble, absorbs in minutes, and delivers 80–90% kavalactone
absorption. The result: faster onset, stronger effects at lower doses, and better-tasting
products.

### What is the NanoOptimizer™ surfactant system?

NanoOptimizer™ is our proprietary blend of food-grade surfactants that encapsulate Kava
particles, making them water-soluble and stable. This system prevents particle
re-aggregation, ensures consistent dosing, and allows the nano Kava to remain suspended
indefinitely without separation or settling.

### How fast does nano Kava work?

Most users report feeling effects within 5 minutes of consumption, compared to 30–45
minutes for traditional Kava. This rapid onset is due to the ultra-small particle size
allowing for immediate absorption through the oral mucosa and GI tract.

## Dosing and safety

### What dosage should I use in my products?

Dosing depends on your target effects and product format. We recommend starting with
50–100 mg of kavalactones per serving for mild relaxation, 100–200 mg for moderate
effects, and 200–300 mg for stronger effects. Because of the increased bioavailability,
you may need less nano Kava than traditional extracts to achieve the same effects. We
work directly with each client to dial in the perfect dosage for your specific product.

### Is nano Kava safe?

Kava has been consumed safely for thousands of years in Pacific Island cultures. Our nano
Kava uses the same kavalactones, just in a more bioavailable form. We use only noble Kava
varieties and test for purity and potency. As with any supplement, we recommend following
standard Kava safety guidelines and consulting with regulatory experts for your specific
market.

## Formulation

### What products can I make with nano Kava?

Our nano Kava is ideal for: Kava seltzers and sparkling beverages, functional shots and
elixirs, RTD (ready-to-drink) relaxation beverages, wellness tonics, mocktails and alcohol
alternatives — plus any water-based formulation where you need fast-acting, great-tasting
Kava.

### Will nano Kava make my beverage cloudy?

No. One of the key benefits of our ~18nm particle size is crystal-clear formulations.
Traditional Kava extracts create cloudy, unappealing beverages. Our nano Kava stays
perfectly clear and stable, giving your products a premium, professional appearance.

### Does nano Kava taste bitter like traditional Kava?

Our nano Kava has a significantly reduced bitter taste compared to traditional extracts.
Additionally, we offer bitter blocker bundles — proprietary flavor-masking ingredients
that can virtually eliminate any remaining Kava taste. This allows you to create smooth,
palatable products your customers will actually enjoy drinking.

### How stable is nano Kava in beverages?

Our nano Kava emulsion is highly stable with a shelf life of 12+ months when stored
properly. The NanoOptimizer™ system prevents particle re-aggregation, so there's no
separation, settling, or ring around the bottle. Your products will look as good on day
365 as they did on day 1.

## Ordering

### What is the minimum order quantity?

We work with brands of all sizes, from startups to established beverage companies. Minimum
order quantities vary based on your needs. Contact us directly to discuss your specific
requirements — we're flexible and want to help you succeed.

### Can I get samples before ordering?

Absolutely. We encourage all potential partners to test our nano Kava in their
formulations before committing to an order. Contact us to request samples and we'll get
them shipped to you promptly.

### What's the process to get started?

Getting started is simple: (1) schedule a discovery call with Josh to discuss your product
vision, (2) receive samples to test in your formulations, (3) work with us to refine your
product and dial in the perfect dosage, (4) place your order and scale production. Josh
works directly with every client to ensure your success.

### Do you offer white-label or private-label services?

We primarily supply nano Kava as a bulk ingredient for your own branded products. We don't
currently offer finished product manufacturing, but we can recommend trusted co-packers
and formulators if needed.

## Quality and compliance

### What quality certifications do you have?

We maintain strict quality control standards and can provide Certificates of Analysis
(COA) for all batches. Our facility follows GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) guidelines.
We test for potency, purity, heavy metals, and microbial contamination.

### Is your Kava sourced from noble varieties?

Yes, we exclusively use noble Kava varieties, which are the traditional, safe varieties
that have been consumed for centuries. We never use tudei (two-day) Kava or other
non-noble varieties that have been associated with adverse effects.

### Can you provide documentation for regulatory compliance?

Yes, we provide full documentation including COAs, specifications sheets, and safety data.
We can work with your regulatory team to ensure you have everything needed for compliance
in your target markets.

# Nano Mushroom Extracts

**Direct answer:** Cannasol Technologies applies the same nanoemulsification platform
behind its ~18nm Nano Kava to functional mushroom extracts — Lion's Mane, Reishi and
Cordyceps — producing water-soluble, high-bioavailability mushroom ingredients for
beverages.

## Offerings

- **Lion's Mane** — nanoemulsified Lion's Mane extract for water-based functional formats
- **Reishi** — nanoemulsified Reishi extract
- **Cordyceps** — nanoemulsified Cordyceps extract

## Why nanoemulsified mushrooms

- **Faster absorption pathways** — nanoemulsification helps enable faster uptake and a
  more consistent consumer experience.
- **Formulation-friendly** — designed to integrate smoothly in water-based formulations
  with consistent dispersion.
- **Production-ready stability** — optimized for reliable batch-to-batch performance and
  scalable manufacturing workflows.
